name: agent-tracker
description: agent-tracker's lifecycle hooks: one line per Codex session start and end in ~/opt/agent-tracker/data/sessions/<uuid>/lifecycle.jsonl.

interface.shortDescription: Session start and end lines for agent-tracker
interface.longDescription: Runs `agent-tracker hook start|end --agent codex` on SessionStart and SessionEnd, so agent-tracker records each Codex session's lifecycle (pid, tmux pane, folder, boot) like Claude Code's.
